name: Val Town

evidence.paas: 03: hosted Deno execution platform; the customer writes the vals and Val Town runs them on HTTP, cron or other triggers

line: Runs JavaScript and TypeScript HTTP apps, cron jobs and APIs.

free.text: 100k runs/day; public code, 1-min runs, 15-min cron, no domains

cells.regions: US data hosting; app region not published

work.math: $25 a month for Pro covers private vals and a custom domain. 1M daily runs only if requests stay within quota. 100 GB transfer and outside build or certificate costs are not priced. 100 MB uses shared Pro blob storage.

$25 a month for Pro. 1M requests must fit the 1M daily run quota. 250 ms is under the 10-minute run limit; 256 MiB under the 4 GiB worker limit. CPU and concurrency fit: unverified. 100 GB transfer not priced.

$67.19 a month subtotal: Pro $25 + Neon 0.5 CU × 730 hours × $0.106 + 10 GB × $0.35, same dollar currency. Add daily 7-day backups and Val Town transfer (100 GB out + 10 GB database). Same-region/private path unverified.
